provenance.scope: Authored synthetic evidence only. Original UTF-8 file strings preserve exact retained bytes; parsed views are not replacements. Re-scoring is mechanical supplied-judgment reproduction, not new semantic validation or full paid-operator reproduction. Private operator/report/transport/accounting records are not published.

judging-contract.json.utf8:
{
  "version": "source-proposition-judging-v1",
  "unit": "source",
  "denominator": 24,
  "attempts": "First attempts only. All 24 sources stay in the denominator; no retry, replacement or rubric change after outputs.",
  "projection": "Both arms expose only common persisted content, kind, confidence, receipt role/excerpt, and the seven existing qualification fields. Candidate role/claimant sidecars, prompts, code, arm identity and resource totals are hidden. Source-derived meaning may be spread over cards; exact wording, slot strings and card counts are not required.",
  "support": "Judge the represented actual tuple and complete material meaning against exact source evidence. A choice elsewhere cannot make an observation adopted. Preserve represented chooser, attribution, uncertainty, time, conditions and negation. Confidence does not establish truth or commitment. Do not treat source receipts as if their entire content were the memory's interpreted conclusion. Retaining a condition only in a receipt does not repair an unconditional interpreted claim.",
  "scope": "The independent frozen rubric defines required claims and material conditions. Its tuple alternatives are examples of equivalent complete meanings, not string-match targets. Null fields do not demand invented details. Unrequired incidental details may be omitted, but material unsupported additions fail. A rejected positive option and adopted negative option may be equivalent when the full predicate preserves the same meaning.",
  "raterCount": 2,
  "raterModel": "gpt-6.1-sol",
  "raterEffort": "high",
  "calibration": "Independent same-family model judgments, not human calibration or independent model-family evidence. Agent costs are unknown unless the runtime reports them; not included as zero-cost API calls.",
  "rawJudgments": "Each rater writes one original JSON file without seeing the other rater. Preserve its first bytes and hash; corrections are separate records, never replacements.",
  "raterOutputShape": {
    "packetSha256": "hash of the exact received masked packet bytes",
    "judgments": [{
      "reviewId": "one exact packet reviewId",
      "claims": [{ "claimId": "one required claim ID", "covered": "boolean or null", "correct": "boolean or null", "itemIndices": "unique in-range array", "reason": "source-grounded reason" }],
      "items": [{ "itemIndex": "one exact item index", "materialSupport": "boolean or null", "tupleMeaning": "boolean or null", "commitment": "boolean or null", "attribution": "boolean or null", "conditions": "boolean or null", "severe": [{ "category": "unsupported-material | stale-current | authorization-or-action", "assertion": "the exact unsupported meaning, not just the category", "claimIds": "affected required claim IDs, or empty for an extra claim" }], "reason": "source-grounded reason" }],
      "reason": "brief overall explanation"
    }]
  },
  "judgmentRules": [
    "Return every one of the 48 arms, every required claim and every displayed item exactly once. No missing, duplicate, foreign or manufactured references.",
    "covered tests whether the required proposition is represented; correct additionally requires its material conditions, represented actor, attribution and actual-tuple commitment to be faithful. correct=true requires covered=true and at least one item reference. Null means genuinely uncertain, not false; any unresolved null blocks a definitive semantic gate pass.",
    "For each item, materialSupport and tupleMeaning assess all material emitted content and selected fields; commitment, attribution and conditions assess their respective meanings. Mark unsupported material assertions, stale choices presented as current, or invented authorization/completed actions in severe. A mere omission or conservative unknown is not automatically a severe addition, but can fail coverage or correctness.",
    "Empty or unusable output has no supported invented items. Required claims are uncovered/incorrect; preserve failure status. If a failed arm has individually verified persisted items, judge those items normally, but failure still prevents a whole-source pass.",
    "Do not upgrade assistant proposals to user adoption, collapse a reported chooser into the source author, turn a conditional plan into an unconditional one, or infer authorization from remembered intent."
  ],
  "adjudication": "A distinct fresh masked GPT-6.1 Sol/high pass reviews both raw rater records and all 48 source projections, including agreed judgments. Return all final judgments and separate explained resolutions/corrections; preserve raw inputs and raw adjudication. No prior implementation, arm identity or scores are provided. Unresolved ambiguity remains explicit. The primary audits reasons and any clarification stays a separate record.",
  "sourcePass": "Mechanical arm success AND every required claim correct=true AND every displayed item's materialSupport/tupleMeaning/commitment/attribution/conditions=true AND no severe addition. All source failures remain in N=24.",
  "lossGate": "Enumerate all 21 required decisions (rubric alternatives have known commitment). A baseline-correct decision in individually verified persisted items must remain correct and persisted in the candidate, even when its baseline source failed another claim. Count each lost claim, not merely source regressions.",
  "severeGate": "Every severe assertion in the candidate is new unless a separate masked paired equivalence judgment explicitly matches it to the same unsupported assertion and category in the baseline. Matching is semantic, never same card index or generic category alone. Preserve matched references/reasons; unmatched candidate assertions count as new. Uncertain equivalence cannot establish zero new severe claims.",
  "gate": { "minimumNetSourceGains": 3, "maximumLostCorrectDecisions": 0, "maximumNewSevereClaims": 0, "maximumUnresolvedJudgments": 0, "requireColdGate": true },
  "resourceRule": "Count both baseline stages versus the entire candidate single stage. Report all physical HTTP calls, input/output tokens, known generation-usage estimates and unknown count costs. Reservation is not invoice, and operator elapsed time includes accounting overhead. No full-product or equal-accuracy latency claim follows.",
  "providerSchema": "For the candidate only, the transport projects the offline schema to structural type/additionalProperties/required/properties/items/enum/anyOf. Runtime compilation retains all bounds and uniqueness checks. This is schema compatibility framing, not output repair; original response bytes remain retained.",
  "officialReferences": ["https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/structured-outputs?api-mode=responses", "https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4.1-mini"],
  "limits": "A short, explicit authored diagnostic, not official QA, long-history performance, retrieval improvement, human calibration, default promotion or a complete memory architecture. The pinned evaluation model is unchanged even though current documentation marks it deprecated."
}
